source_text: Design a closure that keeps a lid shut until a person opens it.
product_intent: A mechanism that maintains a lid in a closed position until an intentional action by a person causes it to open.
user_intent_summary: Design a closure that keeps a lid shut until a person opens it.

clauses.text: Design a closure that keeps a lid shut until a person opens it.

requirements.statement: The closure must maintain the lid in a closed position until an intentional action by a person causes it to open.

verification.observable: Lid remains closed without intentional action by a person
verification.condition: No external force applied to open the lid

requirements.statement: The closure must allow a person to open the lid through intentional action.

verification.observable: Lid opens when a person applies intentional force or action
verification.condition: Person intentionally acts on the closure mechanism

operating_scenarios.name: Normal operation with intentional opening
operating_scenarios.description: A person applies intentional force or action to open the closure mechanism, allowing the lid to be opened.

operating_scenarios.name: Default closed state
operating_scenarios.description: The closure maintains the lid in a closed position without any external force or intentional action applied.

relations.rationale: The closure must maintain the lid in a closed position until a person opens it, which implies that opening is possible and intentional.

discovery_outcomes.reason: No freedom clauses were present in the request.
No assumptions were needed to be made beyond what was explicitly stated.
The request provided sufficient information to define the required behaviors without any unknowns.
